versions.changelog:
- Added new `flight_tracker.py` script.
- Updated instructions: `--origin` argument is now required for `flight_tracker.py` to avoid false matches on same-callsign flights.
- SKILL.md revised with new sample invocations and output for `flight_tracker.py`.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md` file.
- Documentation is now clearer regarding origin/destination handling and script usage.

**Version 1.2.0 of flight-pickup-tracker introduces privacy clarifications and improved user prompts.**

- Clarified scope of the skill: only for active flight pickup coordination, not general flight info.
- Revised usage instructions to require explicit user confirmation of pickup address before using (do not silently default to home address).
- Added a new "Privacy & Data Disclosure" section highlighting when and how user data is sent to APIs.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.
- Updated Google Maps API key usage notes and example commands for better clarity.

- Added support for running without a Google Maps API key: skill now estimates drive time based on distance and time of day if a key is not configured.
- Updated documentation to clarify optionality of Google Maps key and new estimation method for drive time.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- No changes to core tracking or notification logic; all end-to-end features work with or without Maps API key.

Initial release – track flights in real-time and notify users when to leave for airport pickup.

- Monitors live flight location using OpenSky Network; calculates distance and ETA to destination airport.
- Retrieves real-time driving time with traffic via Google Maps Directions API.
- Combines flight ETA and drive time to determine the optimal "leave by" time and sends proactive alerts.
- Includes example scripts for both flight tracking and drive time calculation.
- Supports major US and international airlines and airports out of the box.
